title: API キーはどこから漏れるのか？ 自分のサイトに来た .env 探し 1,566 件と、公開事例を 7 つの経路に分けてみた

ja_summary:
・APIキー流出の主な経路は、公開リポジトリやWebサイトの公開フォルダへの誤配置など計7つに分類される。

title: Anybody Can Generate Code. Can Your AI Ship It? - Devfest Hyderabad 2026
summary:
AI coding agents can generate entire features, refactor applications and write tests in minutes. But producing code is not the same as engineering software we can confidently ship.

What happens when we stop treating AI as a coding assistant and start treating it as an engineering team?

In this session, we'll build a custom AI engineering harness using Google's Gemini, Gemma and Antigravity ecosystem, combining local, open-source and cloud models based on task complexity, cost and privacy requirements.

We'll create specialized agents for architecture, implementation, testing, code review and performance engineering. Using repository-level rules, reusable agent skills, structured handoffs and model routing, we'll orchestrate these agents into a coordinated engineering swarm.

But the real challenge starts when the agents say they're done.

We'll build independent verification layers around AI-generated code: compilation, static analysis, automated tests, UI validation, performance benchmarks and runtime telemetry. Instead of trusting an agent's claim that a task is complete, our harness will collect real engineering evidence.

When an agent introduces a regression, the verification system will identify the failure, feed measurements back into the agent workflow and require another implementation-and-validation cycle before accepting the change.

We'll also explore how local Gemma models enable private and offline development workflows, when to escalate tasks to more capable cloud models, and how multilingual voice interfaces can make agent orchestration more accessible.

The result is more than an AI coding assistant. It's the foundation of a verifiable AI engineering system, with specialized agents, automated quality gates and measurable outcomes.

Anybody can generate code now. The harder question is: can your AI actually ship it?
ja_summary:
AIによるコード生成を「実装」の域を超え、検証・テスト・デプロイまで自律的に完結させるエンジニアリングシステムの構築手法を解説する。
GoogleのGeminiやGemmaを活用し、開発・検証・修正のサイクルを自動化する複数の専門AIエージェントを連携させた開発基盤を提案。
AIの出力を盲信せず、コンパイルや性能ベンチマーク等の客観的証拠に基づいた「信頼性の高い出荷」を実現する検証プロセスの構築を目指す。
